verses.original: וְהָ֣אָדָ֔ם יָדַ֖ע אֶת־ חַוָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַתַּ֙הַר֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־ קַ֔יִן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר קָנִ֥יתִי אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·ḏām yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- ḥaw·wāh ’iš·tōw wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ ’eṯ- qa·yin wat·tō·mer qā·nî·ṯî ’îš ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve and she conceived and gave birth to Cain With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man she said
verses.literalPt: E CONHECEU Adão a Eva, sua mulher, e ela concebeu e deu à luz a Caim, e disse: Alcancei do SENHOR um homem.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣סֶף לָלֶ֔דֶת אֶת־ אָחִ֖יו אֶת־ הָ֑בֶל וַֽיְהִי־ הֶ֙בֶל֙ רֹ֣עֵה צֹ֔אן וְקַ֕יִן הָיָ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ד אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·sep̄ lā·le·ḏeṯ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw ’eṯ- hā·ḇel way·hî- he·ḇel rō·‘êh ṣōn wə·qa·yin hā·yāh ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Later she gave birth to Cain’s brother Abel Now Abel was a keeper of sheep while Cain was a tiller of the soil
verses.literalPt: E deu à luz mais a seu irmão Abel; e Abel foi pastor de ovelhas, e Caim foi lavrador da terra.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י מִקֵּ֣ץ יָמִ֑ים וַיָּבֵ֨א קַ֜יִן מִפְּרִ֧י הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ yā·mîm way·yā·ḇê qa·yin mip·pə·rî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh min·ḥāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: So in the course of time Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu ao cabo de dias que Caim trouxe do fruto da terra uma oferta ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהֶ֨בֶל הֵבִ֥יא גַם־ ה֛וּא מִבְּכֹר֥וֹת צֹאנ֖וֹ וּמֵֽחֶלְבֵהֶ֑ן וַיִּ֣שַׁע יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הֶ֖בֶל וְאֶל־ מִנְחָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·ḇel hê·ḇî ḡam- hū mib·bə·ḵō·rō·wṯ ṣō·nōw ū·mê·ḥel·ḇê·hen way·yi·ša‘ Yah·weh ’el- he·ḇel wə·’el- min·ḥā·ṯōw
verses.literal: while Abel . . . brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock And the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering
verses.literalPt: E Abel também trouxe dos primogênitos das suas ovelhas, e da sua gordura; e atentou o SENHOR para Abel e para a sua oferta.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ קַ֥יִן וְאֶל־ מִנְחָת֖וֹ לֹ֣א שָׁעָ֑ה וַיִּ֤חַר לְקַ֙יִן֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- qa·yin wə·’el- min·ḥā·ṯōw lō šā·‘āh way·yi·ḥar lə·qa·yin mə·’ōḏ way·yip·pə·lū pā·nāw
verses.literal: but He had no regard for Cain and his offering So Cain became very angry and his countenance fell
verses.literalPt: Mas para Caim e para a sua oferta não atentou. E irou-se Caim fortemente, e descaiu-lhe o semblante.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ קָ֑יִן לָ֚מָּה חָ֣רָה לָ֔ךְ וְלָ֖מָּה נָפְל֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- qā·yin lām·māh ḥā·rāh lāḵ wə·lām·māh nā·p̄ə·lū p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Why are you angry said the LORD to Cain and why has your countenance fallen
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR disse a Caim: Por que te iraste? E por que descaiu o teu semblante?

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא אִם־ תֵּיטִיב֙ שְׂאֵ֔ת וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תֵיטִ֔יב לַפֶּ֖תַח חַטָּ֣את רֹבֵ֑ץ וְאֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָת֔וֹ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּמְשָׁל־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’im- tê·ṭîḇ śə·’êṯ wə·’im lō ṯê·ṭîḇ lap·pe·ṯaḥ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ rō·ḇêṣ wə·’ê·le·ḵā tə·šū·qā·ṯōw wə·’at·tāh tim·šāl- bōw
verses.literal: If you do what is right will you not be accepted But if you refuse to do what is right sin is crouching at your door it desires you but you must master it
verses.literalPt: Se bem fizeres, não é certo que serás aceito? E se não fizeres bem, o pecado jaz à porta, e sobre ti será o seu desejo, mas sobre ele deves dominar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל־ הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑יו וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּהְיוֹתָ֣ם בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַיָּ֥קָם קַ֛יִן אֶל־ הֶ֥בֶל אָחִ֖יו וַיַּהַרְגֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qa·yin ’el- he·ḇel ’ā·ḥîw way·hî bih·yō·w·ṯām baś·śā·ḏeh way·yā·qām qa·yin ’el- he·ḇel ’ā·ḥîw way·ya·har·ḡê·hū
verses.literal: Then Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go out to the field.” And while they were in the field Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him
verses.literalPt: E falou Caim com o seu irmão Abel; e sucedeu que, estando eles no campo, se levantou Caim contra o seu irmão Abel, e o matou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ קַ֔יִן אֵ֖י הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵ֥ר אָחִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- qa·yin ’ê he·ḇel ’ā·ḥî·ḵā way·yō·mer lō yā·ḏa‘·tî hă·šō·mêr ’ā·ḥî ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Cain Where is your brother Abel I do not know he answered Am I my brother’s keeper
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Caim: Onde está Abel, teu irmão? E ele disse: Não sei; sou eu guardador do meu irmão?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ ק֚וֹל דְּמֵ֣י אָחִ֔יךָ צֹעֲקִ֥ים אֵלַ֖י מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer meh ‘ā·śî·ṯā qō·wl də·mê ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ṣō·‘ă·qîm ’ê·lay min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: What have you done replied the LORD The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Que fizeste? A voz do sangue do teu irmão clama a mim desde a terra.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אָר֣וּר אָ֑תָּה מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּצְתָ֣ה אֶת־ פִּ֔יהָ לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־ דְּמֵ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ā·rūr ’āt·tāh min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer pā·ṣə·ṯāh ’eṯ- pî·hā lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- də·mê ’ā·ḥî·ḵā mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand
verses.literalPt: E agora maldito és tu desde a terra, que abriu a sua boca para receber da tua mão o sangue do teu irmão.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹֽא־ תֹסֵ֥ף תֵּת־ כֹּחָ֖הּ לָ֑ךְ נָ֥ע וָנָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯa·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lō- ṯō·sêp̄ têṯ- kō·ḥāh lāḵ nā‘ wā·nāḏ tih·yeh ḇā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: When you till the ground it will no longer yield its produce to you You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth
verses.literalPt: Quando lavrares a terra, não te dará mais a sua força; fugitivo e vagabundo serás na terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל עֲוֺנִ֖י מִנְּשֹֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qa·yin ’el- Yah·weh gā·ḏō·wl ‘ă·wō·nî min·nə·śō
verses.literal: But Cain said to the LORD My punishment is greater than I can bear
verses.literalPt: Então disse Caim ao SENHOR: É maior a minha maldade que a que possa ser perdoada.

verses.original: הֵן֩ גֵּרַ֨שְׁתָּ אֹתִ֜י הַיּ֗וֹם מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה וּמִפָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶסָּתֵ֑ר וְהָיִ֜יתִי נָ֤ע וָנָד֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה כָל־ מֹצְאִ֖י יַֽהַרְגֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hên gê·raš·tā ’ō·ṯî hay·yō·wm mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ū·mip·pā·ne·ḵā ’es·sā·ṯêr wə·hā·yî·ṯî nā‘ wā·nāḏ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yāh ḵāl mō·ṣə·’î ya·har·ḡê·nî
verses.literal: Behold this day You have driven me from the face of the earth and from Your face I will be hidden I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth and whoever finds me will kill me
verses.literalPt: Eis que hoje me lanças da face da terra, e da tua face me esconderei; e serei fugitivo e vagabundo na terra, e será que todo aquele que me achar, me matará.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ יְהוָ֗ה לָכֵן֙ כָּל־ הֹרֵ֣ג קַ֔יִן שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקָּ֑ם וַיָּ֨שֶׂם יְהוָ֤ה לְקַ֙יִן֙ א֔וֹת לְבִלְתִּ֥י הַכּוֹת־ אֹת֖וֹ כָּל־ מֹצְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw Yah·weh lā·ḵên kāl- hō·rêḡ qa·yin šiḇ·‘ā·ṯa·yim yuq·qām way·yā·śem Yah·weh lə·qa·yin ’ō·wṯ lə·ḇil·tî hak·kō·wṯ- ’ō·ṯōw kāl- mō·ṣə·’ōw
verses.literal: Not so replied the LORD If anyone slays Cain then Cain will be avenged sevenfold And the LORD placed a mark on Cain so that no one . . . who found him would kill him
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR, porém, disse-lhe: Portanto qualquer que matar a Caim, sete vezes será castigado. E pôs o SENHOR um sinal em Caim, para que o não ferisse qualquer que o achasse.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥צֵא קַ֖יִן מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ נ֖וֹד קִדְמַת־ עֵֽדֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê qa·yin mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yê·šeḇ bə·’e·reṣ- nō·wḏ qiḏ·maṯ- ‘ê·ḏen
verses.literal: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod east of Eden
verses.literalPt: E saiu Caim de diante da face do SENHOR, e habitou na terra de Node, do lado oriental do Éden.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤דַע קַ֙יִן֙ אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־ חֲנ֑וֹךְ וַֽיְהִי֙ בֹּ֣נֶה עִ֔יר וַיִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הָעִ֔יר כְּשֵׁ֖ם בְּנ֥וֹ חֲנֽוֹךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ qa·yin ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ ’eṯ- ḥă·nō·wḵ way·hî bō·neh ‘îr way·yiq·rā šêm hā·‘îr kə·šêm bə·nōw ḥă·nō·wḵ
verses.literal: And Cain had relations with his wife and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch Then Cain built a city and named . . . it after his son Enoch
verses.literalPt: E conheceu Caim a sua mulher, e ela concebeu, e deu à luz a Enoque; e ele edificou uma cidade, e chamou o nome da cidade conforme o nome de seu filho Enoque;

verses.original: וַיִּוָּלֵ֤ד לַֽחֲנוֹךְ֙ אֶת־ עִירָ֔ד וְעִירָ֕ד יָלַ֖ד אֶת־ מְחֽוּיָאֵ֑ל וּמְחִיּיָאֵ֗ל יָלַד֙ אֶת־ מְת֣וּשָׁאֵ֔ל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵ֖ל יָלַ֥ד אֶת־ לָֽמֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·lêḏ la·ḥă·nō·wḵ ’eṯ- ‘î·rāḏ wə·‘î·rāḏ yā·laḏ ’eṯ- mə·ḥū·yā·’êl ū·mə·ḥî·y·yā·’êl yā·laḏ ’eṯ- mə·ṯū·šā·’êl ū·mə·ṯū·šā·’êl yā·laḏ ’eṯ- lā·meḵ
verses.literal: Now to Enoch was born Irad and Irad was the father of Mehujael and Mehujael was the father of Methusael and Methusael was the father of Lamech
verses.literalPt: E a Enoque nasceu Irade, e Irade gerou a Meujael, e Meujael gerou a Metusael e Metusael gerou a Lameque.

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֥וֹ לֶ֖מֶךְ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאַחַת֙ עָדָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית צִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw le·meḵ šə·tê nā·šîm šêm hā·’a·ḥaṯ ‘ā·ḏāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nîṯ ṣil·lāh
verses.literal: And Lamech married . . . two women one named Adah and the other Zillah
verses.literalPt: E tomou Lameque para si duas mulheres; o nome de uma era Ada, e o nome da outra, Zilá.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶד עָדָ֖ה אֶת־ יָבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י יֹשֵׁ֥ב אֹ֖הֶל וּמִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ ‘ā·ḏāh ’eṯ- yā·ḇāl hū hā·yāh ’ă·ḇî yō·šêḇ ’ō·hel ū·miq·neh
verses.literal: Adah gave birth to Jabal he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock
verses.literalPt: E Ada deu à luz a Jabal; este foi o pai dos que habitam em tendas e têm gado.

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יוּבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י כָּל־ תֹּפֵ֥שׂ כִּנּ֖וֹר וְעוּגָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm ’ā·ḥîw yū·ḇāl hū hā·yāh ’ă·ḇî kāl- tō·p̄êś kin·nō·wr wə·‘ū·ḡāḇ
verses.literal: And his brother’s name was Jubal he was the father of all who play the harp and flute
verses.literalPt: E o nome do seu irmão era Jubal; este foi o pai de todos os que tocam harpa e órgão.

verses.original: וְצִלָּ֣ה גַם־ הִ֗וא יָֽלְדָה֙ אֶת־ תּ֣וּבַל קַ֔יִן לֹטֵ֕שׁ כָּל־ חֹרֵ֥שׁ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֑ל וַֽאֲח֥וֹת תּֽוּבַל־ קַ֖יִן נַֽעֲמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣil·lāh ḡam- hî yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- tū·ḇal qa·yin lō·ṭêš kāl- ḥō·rêš nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇar·zel wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ tū·ḇal- qa·yin na·‘ă·māh
verses.literal: And Zillah . . . . . . gave birth to Tubal-cain a forger of every implement of bronze and iron And the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah
verses.literalPt: E Zilá também deu à luz a Tubalcaim, mestre de toda a obra de cobre e ferro; e a irmã de Tubalcaim foi Noema.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לֶ֜מֶךְ לְנָשָׁ֗יו עָדָ֤ה וְצִלָּה֙ שְׁמַ֣עַן קוֹלִ֔י נְשֵׁ֣י לֶ֔מֶךְ הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ הָרַ֙גְתִּי֙ לְפִצְעִ֔י וְיֶ֖לֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer le·meḵ lə·nā·šāw ‘ā·ḏāh wə·ṣil·lāh šə·ma·‘an qō·w·lî nə·šê le·meḵ ha’·zên·nāh ’im·rā·ṯî kî ’îš hā·raḡ·tî lə·p̄iṣ·‘î wə·ye·leḏ lə·ḥab·bu·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Then Lamech said to his wives Adah and Zillah hear my voice wives of Lamech listen to my speech For I have slain a man for wounding me a young man for striking me
verses.literalPt: E disse Lameque a suas mulheres Ada e Zilá: Ouvi a minha voz; vós, mulheres de Lameque, escutai as minhas palavras; porque eu matei um homem por me ferir, e um jovem por me pisar.

verses.original: כִּ֥י שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקַּם־ קָ֑יִן וְלֶ֖מֶךְ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî šiḇ·‘ā·ṯa·yim yuq·qam- qā·yin wə·le·meḵ šiḇ·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: If Cain is avenged sevenfold then Lamech seventy-sevenfold
verses.literalPt: Porque sete vezes Caim será castigado; mas Lameque setenta vezes sete.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨דַע אָדָ֥ם עוֹד֙ אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁ֑ת כִּ֣י שָֽׁת־ לִ֤י אֱלֹהִים֙ זֶ֣רַע אַחֵ֔ר תַּ֣חַת הֶ֔בֶל כִּ֥י הֲרָג֖וֹ קָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ ’ā·ḏām ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw šêṯ kî šāṯ- lî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ze·ra‘ ’a·ḥêr ta·ḥaṯ he·ḇel kî hă·rā·ḡōw qā·yin
verses.literal: And Adam again had relations with his wife and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth saying God has granted me another seed in place of Abel since Cain killed him
verses.literalPt: E tornou Adão a conhecer a sua mulher; e ela deu à luz um filho, e chamou o seu nome Sete; porque, disse ela, Deus me deu outro filho em lugar de Abel; porquanto Caim o matou.

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֤ת גַּם־ הוּא֙ יֻלַּד־ בֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ אָ֣ז הוּחַ֔ל לִקְרֹ֖א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šêṯ gam- hū yul·laḏ- bên way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw ’ĕ·nō·wōš ’āz hū·ḥal liq·rō bə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: And to Seth . . . also a son was born and he called him Enosh At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E a Sete também nasceu um filho; e chamou o seu nome Enos; então se começou a invocar o nome do SENHOR.
